meta.name: add-discord
meta.description: Add Discord bot channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 把 Discord 机器人频道接入你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要为应用添加 Discord 机器人频道
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Discord bot channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to connect Discord bot channels to your application

howto.what: Claude 会把 Discord 适配器代码加进项目并注册,安装固定版本依赖;然后引导你在 Discord 开发者后台创建机器人、粘贴 Bot Token,再自动读取应用 ID、公钥等写入环境配置,重启服务。完成后你的 AI 就能在 Discord 聊天通道中收发消息。
howto.when: 当你想把 AI 助手接入 Discord,或要求添加 Discord 机器人频道时触发。

say.text: 帮我把 Discord 机器人频道加进项目里。
say.note: 开始复制适配器并注册频道。

say.text: 我想在 Discord 里用这个 AI 助手聊天。
say.note: 引导创建机器人并粘贴令牌,其余自动获取。

say.text: 为项目接入 Discord 消息收发。
say.note: 安装依赖、写入环境变量并重启服务。

howto.what_en: Claude adds Discord support: copies/registers the adapter, installs a pinned dependency, guides bot/token setup, stores API-derived credentials, then restarts the service for AI chat on Discord.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to add a Discord bot or channel, or integrate the AI with Discord.

say_en.text: Add a Discord bot channel to the project.
say_en.note: Starts copying and registering the adapter.

say_en.text: I want to chat with this AI over Discord.
say_en.note: Guides you through bot and token setup.

say_en.text: Set up Discord messaging for the project.
say_en.note: Installs dependencies and restarts the service.
